headline: Weathered Expanse Bears Heaviest Fire as Nevish Line Quiets
war_summary: The fighting has shifted since the last edition. Weathered Expanse bears the war's heaviest fire, with more than five thousand Colonial and eight thousand six hundred Warden casualties in the past day, three hundred forty-four and five hundred fifty-nine more in the last two hours; its nine works now stand five Colonial and four unclaimed. Callahan's Passage, lately split, now reports ten Warden posts and none Colonial, the latest event filed at 5:34. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle were the freshest grounds of the morning — seven Colonial works against two Warden in each, five events apiece in the last two hours, the latest at 5:57 and 5:45 respectively. The Nevish Line, busiest of the previous report with fifty-six events in the day, has gone quiet these last two hours while holding six Warden posts against two Colonial. Mooring County's twelve Warden works stand after another sharp spell, and Palantine Berm's seven Warden posts remain after a calmer two hours. No victory has been declared.
